evidence: Ad impressions +14% YoY and average price per ad +12% YoY.
Family daily active people averaged 3.60B in June 2026, +3% YoY.
Q2 FoA operating income $23.394B on FoA revenue $60.370B = 38.75%.
Q2 capex including finance-lease principal $31.08B on revenue $60.801B = 51.12%.

Q2 RL operating loss $4.619B on revenue $0.431B.
Meta expects full-year 2026 RL operating losses to remain similar to 2025; 2025 RL reduced operating profit by ~$19.19B.
